decision.rationale: This dispute was opened too late, so it must be declined. TXN-008000 (118025 EUR minor units, QUAYSIDE OUTFITTERS, card CRD-000011) was posted on 2026-05-22. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 157 days after posting. Policy section time-limits requires a dispute to be opened within 120 days of posting, and says the limit applies even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. The authorisation behind the charge, AUTH-008200, does show signs of fraud: entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and the fraud flag set. Without the time limit, this would point to a card-not-present unauthorised payment, but the time limit comes first and decides the case.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened 157 days after the transaction was posted on 2026-05-22. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, and this limit applies even when a transaction shows signs of fraud.
